title: Playback is in the contract, with examples Octave can mock against.
description: Serves Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need."; Goal 1: "Playback never surprises a viewer.". Split from JS-216 (D-20261127-domains-tasks).
acceptanceCriteria: The contract declares playback: starting one with what the device can play and the tracks chosen, or with no position to start at the viewer's place; the answer saying how it plays and why; a track or quality change within the same playback; ending it; its media link, and the link's refusal once the playback has ended, with the action to start again; its progress reports; and the messages a running playback receives. Each has its request, its answer, who may call it, its reasons and an example.
A refused play is answered with a refusal status and its reason, never inside a successful answer.
Each M1 capability is in the state its design supports: declared until served, preview until Octave confirms it.
The conformance check of JS-183 passes on the whole contract.
The change reaches Octave as a from:jellyscale issue before anything in it is served (D-132).
notes: Phase M1 chosen (split from JS-216, M1); ux flag chosen: true. Plus JS-216's states, conformance and issue criteria.
